scope: Supplement frozen Pro core events and embedded representative cases; no fusion, labels, score, reference or eligibility edits
prior_basis: Latest main 451-event corner panel and four human-feedback examples, not available in Pro input commit; examples motivate dimensions but never fit a nearness threshold
primary: Continuous same-count bound-preserving cyclic corresponding-corner BEV and top-3D mean/max in camera-height h
parallel: Original Pro legacy joint and shape flags unchanged; report disagreement and distance distributions, never replace flags post hoc
normalizations: Keep absolute h and symmetric sqrt(mean footprint area), local mean camera radius; A bbox diagonal retained for historical compatibility only
matching: Normalize winding for matching indices only, choose cyclic shift minimizing worst paired top/bottom historical angular distance; unique numerical solution is a candidate, not semantic equivalence. Report angle and second-best gap
gates_interpretation: Existing neighborhood sensitivity scales, never validated human nearness thresholds
denominator: All events and both arms retained; compare A/B and A/C continuous outcomes only on same events jointly eligible; incomplete/different count/invalid/ambiguous are null, not zero
aggregation: event mean within pool, equal pool within building, equal buildings; report per-building rows and event quantiles separately; statistics worker handles building bootstrap
limitations: Explored internal v2 data and enriched core selection, not unseen external confirmation or full-width prevalence; continuous conditional estimates require separate full-denominator structural/failure rates
